messages:
Maria: Quick heads-upLyra confirmed a Dedicated POC and wants a 12mo reserved path to production. Need price exception and deal-desk review.

Maria: POC asks (summary): 8x A100-equivalent GPU pool, POC baseline ~600 reqs/min, demo spikes could need up to ~12x for short windows, target steady-state ~35-45% after ramp. Region: us-west primary, eu for DR.

Maria: Draft commercial terms I'm preparing: 
```
- Term: 12 months
- Base monthly (blended reserved rate): $92,500
- Included autoscale buffer: 15% of base (no surcharge within buffer)
- Burst surcharge beyond buffer: +35% marginal
- Commit discount: 22% off list for 12mo if Q1 upfront invoice
- POC concession: first 14 days capped at $5k credit
```

Josh: looping in @deal-desk and capacity ops. We can consider 22% if Revenue Ops + Legal sign off and we get the upfront. Need confirmation from Capacity on the 12x burst feasibility.

Sanjay: Infra note: 12x immediate across the pool is unsafe without warm nodes. Our autoscaler reliably hits ~4-6x within 5-10min windows; with pre-warm we can support 10-12x for short durations but that requires a reserved burst block or scheduled ramp.

Sanjay: Suggested SOW language: "Burst capacity available subject to scheduled warm-up or reserved burst allocation. Short-notice instantaneous spikes beyond pre-warmed capacity are best-effort and may be throttled or routed to a compatible lower-capacity model variant." Also: cross-region failover may increase p99 latency by ~10-15% and is not covered by base latency SLA.

Tara: Security: Lyra requests customer-managed KMS + VPC peering and audit logs. Private control plane add-on applies (one-time onboarding fee + monthly mgmt). For EU data we need DPA + SCCs; SOC2 is required. If they want on-prem, that's a separate engagement.

Alice: Finance: numbers look directionally ok. Action: attach itemized monthly run-rate to the ticket. Approvals required: RevenueOps, Legal, CapacityOps. Discount band check: 22% is above standard for a 12mo unless we get upfront Q1 payment + committed ARR threshold.

Maria: Inline calc for transparency:
```
base = 92500
buffer = base * 0.15  # 13,875
burst_rate = 0.35
example_over = (base * 0.08) * burst_rate  # 8% over buffer as sample
total_month = base + buffer + example_over
annual = total_month * 12
```

Maria: Rough estimate -> total_month ~ $110,000, annual ~ $1.32M before commit discount and POC credit.

deal-desk-bot: Ticket created: #DD-3952. Required approvals: [RevenueOps, Legal, CapacityOps]. Please attach SOW + run-rate spreadsheet. Billing cadence (monthly vs upfront) must be specified.

Josh: Action items:
- @Sanjay: formal capacity note + exact warm-up/reserved-burst options for SOW (ETA 24h)
- @Tara: confirm private-control-plane onboarding fee and monthly mgmt charge (ETA EOD)
- @Alice: confirm discount guardrails and wording for upfront incentive (ETA EOD)
- @deal-desk-bot: schedule review once docs are attached to #DD-3952

Sanjay: Will include a capacity appendix with concrete pre-warm steps, an ops runbook for scheduled demo spikes, and a fallback plan to a cheaper model variant.

Tara: I'll attach DPA + SCC checklist and note any extra attestations for EU-resident workloads.

Alice: I'll upload an amortized revenue model (monthly vs upfront) and clarify accounting for the POC credit.

Maria: If CapacityOps and Finance sign off today we can present a short exec summary to Lyra tomorrow. Lyra is asking for a contractual window for demo week in 2 business days.

Josh: +1 on adding a clause to SOW that limits burst SLA to "scheduled/pre-warmed" windows and marks all other spikes as best-effort. Keeps legal safe.

Sanjay: Agreed  I'll draft the clause and include a recommended fallback to a smaller model family if full capacity isn't available.

Maria: Uploading draft SOW -> https://redwood.internal/dd-tickets/DD-3952 and attaching SOW_v0.1.pdf

Alice: Got it. I'll review spreadsheet and push updates to ticket.

deal-desk-bot: Reminder: Ticket will be blocked if SOW, run-rate spreadsheet, billing cadence, or MSA status are missing.

Josh: Lyra wants an explicit demo capacity window locked in contract. Can we provide a 3-day demo reservation option at a known surcharge?

Sanjay: Yes  can offer a paid demo reservation (short-term reserved burst) priced as a percent uplift on base for the reserved days. I'll model pricing in the appendix.
